short_description: Align two small pixel-animation masks on the front screen using an onion-skin comparison.
description: Align two small pixel-animation masks on the front screen using an onion-skin comparison. Set each mask in device settings as slash-separated rows of 0s and 1s, up to 12 columns and 7 rows. Amber and teal are the original layers, and pale pixels mark overlap. Wheel shifts the second mask on the selected axis. Click switches X/Y. Start cycles overlay and single-layer views. Hold Start resets the offset.
